about: #186: the one table for the install-lint setup-refusal copy. service/pack_install_lint.py and web/scripts/pack-install-lint-setup-copy.mjs (bundle-pack-entry.mjs) both read this file; neither has a copy of its own. `reasons` maps each machine-readable setup reason code to a `fixes` entry; a code that isn't listed (or none) uses `default`. `reason_overrides` points a reason at a named `overrides` entry, its own `install` / `upgrade` templates where the shared ones don't fit (`in_time`: "in time", and an upgrade that keeps the old version needs no fix); lint_timeout (the script's timer) and bundle_timeout (the service's backstop) share it, so the user sees one sentence for either kill. `update_refused` (#111) is the upgrade sentence for an update refused because its check couldn't run at all (no setup reason, so no fix); the service renders it (service/pack_install_lint.py format_update_refused_message) next to reasonCode "update_refused". A template the entry doesn't list stays the shared one. `install_unchecked` (#111): a fresh install whose check couldn't run for a reason that isn't a setup one (the staged pack couldn't be read), so the #185 install sentence without a fix, and never a "still on" ending. `updates` (#111): the update that couldn't start, didn't finish, or still couldn't start on Retry; each ends with {still}. The service renders these (service/pack_install_lint.py) and web/src/plugins/pack-install-copy-table.ts reads the same file. `build_failed` (#253): the check ran and the pack's code didn't build (an esbuild error), so neither a block nor a setup refusal: no "blocked", no pack lint, no fix; the service renders it (service/pack_build_failed.py) next to reasonCode "pack_build_failed". Placeholders: {name}, {old}, {new}, {still}, {fix}. tests/test_pack_install_lint_setup_copy.py fails if the service and the script render any entry differently.
install: Couldn't safety-check {name}, so it wasn't installed. {fix}
upgrade: Couldn't safety-check the new version of {name}, so it wasn't updated. {still} {fix}
still_unknown: The version you had is still installed.
install_unchecked: Couldn't safety-check {name}, so it wasn't installed.

build_failed.install: {name} couldn't be built, so it wasn't installed.
build_failed.upgrade: The new version of {name} couldn't be built, so it wasn't updated. {still}

updates.couldnt_start: {name} version {new} couldn't start, so it wasn't updated. {still}
updates.interrupted: The update to {name} didn't finish, so nothing changed. {still}

fixes.pnpm_install: Run `pnpm install` in `web/` and try again.
fixes.pnpm_run_prepare: Run `pnpm run prepare` in `web/` and try again.
fixes.try_again: Try again, and if it keeps happening, the pack may be broken.

in_time.install: Couldn't safety-check {name} in time, so it wasn't installed. {fix}
in_time.upgrade: Couldn't safety-check the new version of {name} in time, so it wasn't updated. {still}

update_refused.upgrade: Couldn't safety-check the new version of {name}, so it wasn't updated. {still}
